name: Clockwork Sentinel, Unwound
body:
UNWOUND CLOCKWORK SENTINEL
CR 1

This man-sized figure formed from metal stands absolutely stationary, with only a faint whir giving away the presence of clockwork within.

XP 400
N Medium construct (clockwork)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 31 (2d10+20)
Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +1
Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft.
Melee 1 slam +4 (1d6+2)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 14, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +4; CMB +4, CMD 16

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Clockwork Wind-up (Ex)

As a move action the Clockwork Sentinel can wind up its second arm. Once wound then on its next turn it has the ability to make a full attack, gaining a second slam attack with the same statistics as the first.

Clockwork Power (Ex)

Spells can be cast into the Clockwork Sentinel to wind up the clockwork within. It gains one charge per level of the spell cast into it and this puts it into one of three states:

0 to 1 charges: Unwound
2 to 8 charges: Normal
9 or 10 charges: Supercharged

The Clockwork Sentinel cannot store more than 10 charges and normal running causes it to lose 1 charge per week. At the DM’s discretion high amounts of activity may cause it to lose charges more rapidly.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, or watch (2-12)
Treasure none

Clockwork Sentinels were creating by an eccentric gnome wizard. He had originally intended them to absorb hostile spells cast at them in order to power their workings but he didn’t manage to get that part of the plan working reliably before he lost interest in the project.

With their darkvision and lack of need to for sleep they make excellent, if unintelligent, sentries. In an Unwound state though they can be slow to react and do not always spot everything they should.
